objective: Make the state branch start from the remote's holyagent/state even when the clone has not fetched it, make state commits survive a .gitignore that ignores .holyagent/, and lower the effort of four specialist routes.
scope: packages/runtime/src/state/tree.ts ensureWorktree (about lines 427-472) and the state commit path that runs git add -A -- .holyagent.
constraints: Follow .claude/CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md of the repository (Effect, Schema, JSDoc on exports, Bun APIs).

Other writers edit other paths of the same tree at the same time: touch only your ownership paths, and run the type-check, lint and the tests of your changed files (bun test <files>, mise run check, mise run lint) rather than judging others work in progress.

Keep working until everything asked is done; stop to ask only when you cannot go on. When done and checked, stop and report with the changed paths and a diff-file evidence path (git diff -- <your paths>, new files included with git diff --no-index or git add -N avoided: list new files separately, saved under /tmp/holyagent-review/); do not add unrequested features or refactors (name them in the report).

criteria.text: Remote fetch: when neither the local branch nor refs/remotes/origin/<state branch> exists, the CLI fetches the state branch from origin (quietly, tolerating an offline or missing remote) and, when it arrives, starts the local branch from it with tracking; only otherwise it starts from the base
Ignored state: committing state in the state worktree succeeds when the branch's .gitignore ignores /.holyagent/ (as a branch started from main does), without changing the work branch's ignore rules
Routes: Worker.operations, Worker.validation and Worker.mechanical are haiku with medium effort and Worker.integration is sonnet with medium effort; every other route is unchanged
Tests: a test for each of the three changes fails without it, including a clone whose origin has holyagent/state but that has no remote-tracking ref for it
Scope: only the ownership paths change
